decisions.reason: Results for the check-in app were far below aspiration during the COVID collapse in aviation, but the 2022 travel recovery and demand for contactless processing make it cheap to keep as part of the established airport offer rather than redirect its modest resources.

PassBoard was launched prominently as a multi-model line that fits the firm's high-end innovation strategy, and as passenger volumes return management will likely wait for evidence instead of writing off this flagship development.

Self-service check-in fits airlines' post-pandemic cost-cutting and touchless needs, so despite weak pandemic-era results it is likely kept as the market recovers, though slack is thin enough that consolidation with the other products is possible.
